audioFormat.description: Format used when Audio only is on.
audioFormat.title: Audio file format

audioOnly.description: Download only the audio track of videos. Photos and GIFs are skipped. Files are extracted with ffmpeg and file saving is enabled automatically.
audioOnly.title: Audio only (extract sound from videos)

downloadAllQualities.description: Emit and download one separate file for every progressive MP4 quality X offers (for example 1080p, 720p, 480p) instead of only the preferred one. Every quality gets its own row, filename and download link.
downloadAllQualities.title: Download every video quality

imageQuality.description: Quality to use for photos (and video poster images). Original is the full-resolution file posted on X.
imageQuality.title: Photo quality

includeAltText.description: Attach the alt text (image description) X stores for each photo or video thumbnail to the media row.
includeAltText.title: Include image alt text

includeMetadata.description: Attach the post text, date, conversation and reply/quote flags, hashtags, mentions, links, like/repost/reply/quote/bookmark/view counts, author name, avatar, verification and follower count, and a derived engagement rate to every downloaded file.
includeMetadata.title: Include post and author metadata

includePosterImage.description: Save the thumbnail/poster image of each video or GIF as an additional photo file.
includePosterImage.title: Also save video poster images

includeQuotedMedia.description: Also download the photos, videos and GIFs that appear inside a quoted post (a post embedded in the linked post). Those rows are marked with mediaSource "quoted post".
includeQuotedMedia.title: Include media from quoted posts

maxItems.description: Hard cap on dataset rows for the whole run. The actor stops collecting and downloading once this many files are emitted.
maxItems.title: Maximum media files to collect

maxPostsPerUser.description: How many of each profile's most recent media posts to look at. Posts without matching media or filtered-out posts are skipped.
maxPostsPerUser.title: Maximum media posts to check per username

mediaTypes.description: Choose which kinds of media to download. All types are selected by default.
mediaTypes.title: Media types to download

minLikes.description: When scanning usernames, skip posts with fewer likes than this. Posts whose like count is unknown are kept. Leave at 0 to keep every post.
minLikes.sectionDescription: Optional filters applied while scanning usernames. Directly linked posts are always collected.
minLikes.title: Minimum likes (profile scans)

minRetweets.description: When scanning usernames, skip posts with fewer reposts than this. Posts whose repost count is unknown are kept. Leave at 0 to keep every post.
minRetweets.title: Minimum reposts (profile scans)

onlyVerifiedAuthors.description: When scanning usernames, skip posts whose author is not verified. Posts where verification is unknown are kept.
onlyVerifiedAuthors.title: Only verified authors (profile scans)

postUrls.description: Paste links of posts to download media from. Accepts x.com and twitter.com links, i/web/status links, or bare post IDs. Optional if you provide usernames or profile links below.
postUrls.title: Post links or IDs

saveToFile.description: Download each file into this run's key-value store and add a public signed download link. Turn off to collect metadata and direct CDN links only.
saveToFile.title: Save files and return download links

usernames.description: Scan a profile's media posts and download their photos, videos and GIFs. Type handles with or without @, or paste full profile links. Optional if you provide post links above.
usernames.title: Usernames or profile links to scan

videoQuality.description: Preferred video resolution. The actor picks the closest available quality when the exact one is not offered.
videoQuality.title: Video quality
